# Evidence Span

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EvidenceSpan`](gmeow-EvidenceSpan.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EvidenceSpan>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/evidence`](../../slices/evidence.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An anchored target span within a resource — a text quote, character position, fragment identifier, page, or generic locator. Generalized from the citation-selector model to serve both evidentiary claims (GraphRAG provenance design/EvidenceSpan audit machinery) and annotation targets (annotation target span). The selector properties ([`selectorTextQuote`](../properties/gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md), [`selectorTextPosition`](../properties/gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md), [`selectorPage`](../properties/gmeow-selectorPage.md), [`selectorLocator`](../properties/gmeow-selectorLocator.md)) are asserted on [`EvidenceSpan`](gmeow-EvidenceSpan.md) individuals and inherited by [`Selector`](gmeow-Selector.md) instances. No second selector model is minted ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gmeow:JustificationGround`](gmeow-JustificationGround.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:EvidenceSpan`](gmeow-EvidenceSpan.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gmeow:JustificationGround`](gmeow-JustificationGround.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to anchor the exact location within a source that backs a claim or carries an annotation — a quote, character offset, fragment, page, or locator — so evidence points at a span, not merely at a whole document; the shared selector target for citations and notes ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a second selector model (this one is reused by both citations and annotations) and avoid pointing it at the whole resource when a precise span is available; reserve the bare resource link for cases with no usable locator.

### How to use

- Mint the span as an [`EvidenceSpan`](gmeow-EvidenceSpan.md) (or a [`Selector`](gmeow-Selector.md) specialization), assert the applicable selector properties ([`gmeow:selectorTextQuote`](../properties/gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md), [`gmeow:selectorTextPosition`](../properties/gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md), [`gmeow:selectorPage`](../properties/gmeow-selectorPage.md), [`gmeow:selectorLocator`](../properties/gmeow-selectorLocator.md)), and link it from the [`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md) or annotation target so the warrant resolves to an exact, auditable location.

### Examples

- ex:span a [`gmeow:EvidenceSpan`](gmeow-EvidenceSpan.md); [`gmeow:selectorTextQuote`](../properties/gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md) "founded in 1998"; [`gmeow:selectorPage`](../properties/gmeow-selectorPage.md) 12.
